description: Sweep this organisation's units and report which regulatory checks are failing across the portfolio, how many units each affects, and examples to open. This is the tool for "which of my units have a broken custody chain", "what is failing right now", "what will not pass on 18 February" and "how are we doing overall". Counts are exact for the units swept; the response says when it hit its cap rather than implying it saw everything. An empty findings list means nothing failed among the units swept — it does not mean the organisation is compliant.

pack.description: Optional: "dscsa" or "dpp". Omit to sweep under every pack.

status.description: Optional: only units in this state (in_transit, in_stock, dispensed, recalled...).

name: chain_readiness
